pending_interview.question: A large regional bank approaches you to build an AI-powered document review tool for their loan underwriting process. They have a 20-person internal data team, a substantial amount of historical loan data, and existing vendor contracts with two major cloud providers. Leadership wants to know whether they should build a custom model in-house, fine-tune an existing foundation model (a large pre-trained AI model that can be adapted to specific tasks), or license a ready-made third-party solution. Walk me through how you would scope this decision with the client, what questions you would ask first, and what your recommendation framework looks like.
